title: Crews
intro: Every crew with founder, region, join mode and status, deleted ones included. Hiding is a DSA decision; the founder gets the statement of reasons.
caption: Crews, newest first
empty_body: Once members found a crew, it shows up here.

record.error: The crew could not be loaded
record.no_members_deleted: The memberships ended when the crew was deleted.
record.members_caption: Crew members: founder, admins, then members
record.no_members_ended: Nobody was left in the crew, so Speedclub ended it.

hide.title: Hide “:name”
hide.body: The crew disappears from lists, search and its page; only its members still see it. The founder gets the statement of reasons and can appeal.

unhide.title: Show “:name” again
unhide.body: The decision is reversed and the crew is visible to everyone again. The founder is told why.
unhide.facts_hint: The founder reads this, 10 to 5000 characters.

remove.title: Delete “:name”
remove.body: The crew is then gone for its members too. Memberships and the name are kept so it can be restored after an appeal.

restore.title: Restore “:name”
restore.body: The crew comes back hidden: its members see it again; it only becomes public with “Show again”.

flash.hidden: Crew hidden, the founder has been told
flash.restored: Crew restored, it is still hidden
flash.not_possible: That is no longer possible in the crew's current state. Reload the page.
